- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated £3.7k revenue TW, the highest performing product, with 1,382 units sold across 79 orders.
- RED HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER achieved £1.8k revenue TW and ranked second by revenue, driven by 45 orders in the week.
- SET/3 RUSSIAN DOLL STACKING TINS and KENSINGTON COFFEE SET each contributed over £1.6k revenue TW, rounding out the top four products.
- ASSORTED FLOWER COLOUR "LEIS" led unit sales TW with 1,494 units, followed by PACK OF 72 RETRO SPOT CAKE CASES at 1,445 units.
- Total revenue reached £61.8k TW, representing a 46.0% WoW increase from £42.3k LW.
- CHERRY DESIGN PAPERLANTERNS showed exceptional growth with a 14,999.8% WoW revenue increase, while BALLERINA HEART DECORATION grew 12,688.5% WoW.
- Total units sold TW reached 29,849 across 1,820 orders, demonstrating strong customer engagement across the product range.
